description: Updates an existing task in Salesforce with new information. Only provided fields will be updated.

activity_date.description: Updated due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
activity_date.human_parameter_description: Pick the new due date for the task in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank to keep the current due date.
activity_date.title: Activity Date

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Priority_Level__c': 'High').
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: A dictionary to update custom fields on the task. Use the API name of each custom field (ending in '__c') as the key and the new value as the value.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

description.description: Updated description or notes. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
examples: Updated: Meeting scheduled for next week
Progress: Sent initial proposal, waiting for response
description.human_parameter_description: Add or update the task's notes or details. Leave blank to keep the current description.
description.title: Description

is_reminder_set.description: Whether to set/unset a reminder. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
is_reminder_set.human_parameter_description: Turn the task's reminder on or off. If turning it on, also provide a Reminder Date/Time.
is_reminder_set.title: Is Reminder Set

priority.description: Updated priority level. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
priority.human_parameter_description: Set how important the task is (High, Normal, or Low). Leave blank to keep the current priority.
priority.title: Priority

reminder_date_time.description: Updated reminder date/time in ISO format. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
reminder_date_time.human_parameter_description: When the reminder should alert you, in ISO format (e.g., 2025-09-14T14:30:00). Use this if you are enabling a reminder.
reminder_date_time.title: Reminder Date Time

status.description: Updated status. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
status.human_parameter_description: Choose the new status for the task (for example, Not Started, In Progress, or Completed). Leave blank to keep the current status.
status.title: Status

subject.description: Updated subject/title of the task. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
subject.human_parameter_description: The new title you want for the task. Leave blank to keep the current subject.
subject.title: Subject

task_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the task to update.
task_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the Salesforce task you want to update. You can get this from the task's URL or from a previous search/list.
task_id.title: Task Id

what_id.description: Updated related record ID. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
what_id.human_parameter_description: The record this task is related to (like an Account, Opportunity, or Case ID). Provide a new ID to change it, or leave blank to keep the current link.
what_id.title: What Id

who_id.description: Updated Contact or Lead ID. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
who_id.human_parameter_description: The person this task is about (a Contact or Lead ID). Provide a new ID to change it, or leave blank to keep the current person.
who_id.title: Who Id

name: update_task

SalesforceError.description: Error object returned in success response (v46+) or standalone error response.

errorCode.description: Standardized error code identifier (e.g., MALFORMED_ID, FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION, NOT_FOUND)
errorCode.title: Error Code

fields.description: Array of field names where the error occurred or that caused the error
fields.title: Fields

statusCode.description: Error code identifier for the type of error (only in success response errors array)
statusCode.title: Status Code

SalesforceError.title: SalesforceError

UpdateTaskResponse.description:
Response schema for Salesforce PATCH update operation on Task object.

The response varies based on API version:
- API version 45 and earlier: HTTP 204 (No Content) with empty response body
- API version 46 and later: HTTP 200 (OK) with response body containing id, success, errors, created

For failed operations (HTTP 4xx or 5xx), the response is an array of error objects.

created.description: Indicates whether a new record was created - false for PATCH updates (API v46+)
created.title: Created

errors.description: Array of error objects - empty array for successful operations (API v46+), or populated array for error responses
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The Salesforce ID of the updated record (API v46+)
id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful (API v46+)
success.title: Success

UpdateTaskResponse.title: UpdateTaskResponse
